title: 420Explorer canonical qualification ledger
authority_order: EXP-0.3 authoritative requirement and status artifacts
EXP-0.4.3 exact-head provenance for scoped repository evidence

qualification_layers.source_qualified: Repository source/static checks passed on the recorded exact head.
qualification_layers.integration_qualified: Cross-component repository/integration checks passed on the recorded exact head.
qualification_layers.runtime_qualified: A production-equivalent runtime composition was executed and evidenced on the recorded exact head/environment.
qualification_layers.deployment_qualified: The intended deployed service identity/configuration was verified and evidenced.
qualification_layers.live_network_qualified: Approved live/testnet endpoint and representative witnesses were verified.
qualification_layers.genesis_qualified: All applicable acceptance criteria and blockers are closed on the exact release candidate.

canonical_rules: This ledger is the current crosswalk; it does not replace the source authority files it reconciles.
Every mandatory Genesis requirement appears exactly once and retains its authoritative current status.
Every AC appears exactly once and remains unverified until exact-release-candidate evidence and blocker closure exist.
Every active Genesis blocker appears exactly once and maps bidirectionally to affected requirements and ACs.
Repository exact-head evidence may support source/integration state only; it cannot self-promote runtime, deployment, live-network or Genesis state.
Historical or broad qualified wording receives the EXP-0.4.6 disposition and cannot override this ledger.
Promotion requires all mapped blockers resolved, all mapped later procedures/evidence layers complete, and exact release-candidate closeout where applicable.

requirements.name: block

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Compare representative indexed block number/hash/parent/timestamp and head/safe/finalized classification against the approved canonical testnet source, including reorg handling above finality.
Navigate recent and historical block views in the deployed Explorer and verify finality labels, logs and navigation against API responses.
Run production-equivalent live required-view probes against the exact release candidate.

requirements.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

requirements.name: transaction

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Implement and test authoritative actual-fee fields, including known fee vectors and edge/zero cases; verify API serialization.
Verify deployed transaction UI shows hash, provenance, success/revert, finality, logs, value and actual fee distinctly.
Compare representative deployed transaction and receipt fields with canonical target-network evidence.

requirements.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

requirements.name: receipt/logs

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Exercise receipt/log APIs with representative successful, reverted, contract-creation and multi-log transactions and compare all provenance fields to canonical records.
Implement/verify complete raw log topic values and data rendering, including empty/multiple topic cases and navigation links.
Run live receipt/log witnesses on the deployed Explorer against the exact release candidate.

requirements.promotion_gate: May advance only after the recorded source/feature gaps are remediated, mapped tests pass, and later runtime/deployment evidence is produced.
